ucs.title: [LLM] Octo Tempest (Scattered Spider) federated-trust backdoor in Entra ID
ucs.description: Hunts for Entra ID federation-trust modification and high-privilege service-principal credential additions — the post-compromise persistence move documented by Microsoft for Octo Tempest / UNC3944 / Storm-0875, where the crew converts help-desk-driven AD takeover into the ability to mint SAML tokens for any user in the tenant (the 'Golden SAML'-style backdoor that survives password resets and MFA re-enrollment).
ucs.splunk:
`o365_management_activity` Workload=AzureActiveDirectory Operation IN ("Set federation settings on domain","Set domain authentication","Add service principal.","Add service principal credentials.","Update application – Certificates and secrets management ","Add app role assignment to service principal.","Consent to application.")
| rename UserId as user, ClientIP as src
| eval target=coalesce('ModifiedProperties{}.NewValue','ObjectId','Target{}.ID')
| stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Operation) as ops values(target) as targets values(UserAgent) as ua dc(Operation) as op_variety by user src
| where op_variety>=1
| convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where Application in~ ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
| where ActionType in~ (
    "Set federation settings on domain",
    "Set domain authentication",
    "Add unverified domain",
    "Add service principal.",
    "Add service principal credentials.",
    "Update application – Certificates and secrets management ",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal.",
    "Consent to application.")
| where AccountDisplayName !endswith "$"
| extend Target = tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name), CountryCode = tostring(CountryCode)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Ops=make_set(ActionType,8), Targets=make_set(Target,8), Sources=make_set(IPAddress,8), Countries=make_set(CountryCode,4), UAs=make_set(UserAgent,4)
          by AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationName in (
    "Set federation settings on domain",
    "Set domain authentication",
    "Add unverified domain",
    "Add service principal",
    "Add service principal credentials",
    "Update application – Certificates and secrets management ",
    "Add app role assignment to service principal",
    "Consent to application")
| extend InitiatorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatorIp  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         InitiatorApp = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         TargetName   = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
         TargetType   = tostring(TargetResources[0].type)
| where Result =~ "success"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
            Ops=make_set(OperationName,8), Targets=make_set(TargetName,8),
            TargetTypes=make_set(TargetType,4), Ips=make_set(InitiatorIp,8)
          by InitiatorUpn, InitiatorApp
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider / Octo Tempest - Federation Trust Backdoor in Entra ID
id: 4a1f3e88-7c12-4b6a-9d3e-12fa7891b9c5
status: experimental
description: Detects modification of Entra ID federation settings, addition of service-principal credentials, or unverified domain additions - the post-compromise persistence chain Microsoft has attributed to Octo Tempest (Scattered Spider, UNC3944) for surviving password resets and MFA re-enrollment after a help-desk takeover.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/13
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1484.002
  - attack.t1098.003
  - attack.g1015
logsource:
  product: azure
  service: auditlogs
detection:
  selection:
    OperationName:
      - 'Set federation settings on domain'
      - 'Set domain authentication'
      - 'Add unverified domain'
      - 'Add service principal'
      - 'Add service principal credentials'
      - 'Update application \u2013 Certificates and secrets management '
      - 'Add app role assignment to service principal'
      - 'Consent to application'
    Result: success
  filter_msft_service:
    InitiatedBy|contains: 'Microsoft Substrate Management'
  condition: selection and not filter_msft_service
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate identity-provider rollout, hybrid-join configuration, B2B federation or planned admin maintenance on registered apps - verify against change-management tickets.
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.outcome:success @evt.name:("Set federation settings on domain" OR "Set domain authentication" OR "Add unverified domain" OR "Add service principal" OR "Add service principal credentials" OR "Add app role assignment to service principal" OR "Consent to application") -@user.userPrincipalName:(*\#EXT\#* OR Sync_*)
ucs.rationale: Microsoft's Octo Tempest deep-dive and Mandiant's UNC3944 reporting both highlight federated-identity manipulation as a Scattered Spider signature - the crew uses it specifically because help-desk-driven password resets and MFA re-enrollment (their initial-access pattern) only buy them user-level access, while federation modification grants tenant-wide identity forgery that survives credential rot

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM deployment chained to help-desk MFA/password reset
ucs.description: Hunts the Scattered Spider / 0ktapus / Muddled Libra signature chain: vishing-driven help-desk MFA or password reset followed within 24h by the install or execution of a portable, signed remote-access tool (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Atera, Pulseway, Action1, FleetDeck, TacticalRMM, ngrok, cloudflared) on the same user's endpoint - the tradecraft CISA AA23-320A and Microsoft call out for UNC3944 / Octo Tempest persistence after social-engineering the service desk.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","atera_agent.exe","ninjarmm.exe","ninjaonline.exe","pulseway.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","fleetdeck.exe","action1_remote.exe","remoteutilities.exe","gotoassist.exe","supremo.exe","zoho_assist.exe","syncro.exe","mremoteng.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe")
    by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=t min(_time) as reset_time from datamodel=Change
        where Change.action="modified" Change.change_type="AAA"
              (Change.command="Reset user password" OR Change.command="Reset password (by admin)" OR Change.command="User registered security info" OR Change.command="Reset user MFA" OR Change.command="Update user")
        by Change.user
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Change)`
  ]
| where first_seen >= reset_time AND first_seen <= (reset_time + 86400)
| eval delay_min=round((first_seen - reset_time)/60, 1)
| convert ctime(reset_time) ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen)
| table reset_time first_seen delay_min user dest process_name parent cmdline
| sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let RmmExe = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","atera_agent.exe","ninjarmm.exe","ninjaonline.exe","pulseway.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","rmmservice.exe","fleetdeck.exe","action1_remote.exe","remoteutilities.exe","rsupport.exe","supremo.exe","desktopnow.exe","zoho_assist.exe","gotoassist.exe","syncro.exe","mremoteng.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe"]);
let RecentResets =
    IdentityDirectoryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where ActionType has_any ("Password","MFA","security info","Strong Authentication")
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn = tolower(AccountUpn), TargetObjectId = AccountObjectId, ResetActor = AdditionalFields;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(2d)
| where FileName in~ (RmmExe) or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (RmmExe)
     or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("anydesk","screenconnect","atera_agent","ninjarmm","pulseway","splashtop","tacticalrmm","fleetdeck","action1","ngrok.exe","cloudflared","teamviewer","remoteutilities","gotoassist","supremo","zoho_assist","syncro","mremoteng")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend UserKey = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner (RecentResets) on $left.UserKey == $right.TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + 24h)
| project Timestamp, ResetTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ResetTime),
          DeviceName, AccountUpn, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RmmExe = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.client.exe","splashtop.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","atera_agent.exe","ninjarmm.exe","pulseway.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","fleetdeck.exe","action1_remote.exe","remoteutilities.exe","gotoassist.exe","supremo.exe","zoho_assist.exe","syncro.exe","mremoteng.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe"]);
let RecentResets =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset user password","Reset password (by admin)","User registered security info","Update user","Admin reset of MFA registration","Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails")
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ResetOp = OperationName, ResetIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(2d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any (RmmExe)
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend TargetUpn = tolower(strcat(TargetUserName, "@", TargetDomainName))
| join kind=inner RecentResets on TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + 24h)
| project TimeGenerated, ResetTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ResetTime),
          Computer, TargetUpn, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, ResetOp, ResetIp
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(AnyDesk|ScreenConnect\.Client(Service)?|Splashtop|SRService|TeamViewer(_Service)?|Atera_Agent|NinjaRMM|NinjaOnline|Pulseway|TacticalRMM|RmmService|FleetDeck|Action1_Remote|RemoteUtilities|GoToAssist|Supremo|Zoho_Assist|Syncro|mRemoteNG|ngrok|cloudflared)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=10}, field=aid, include=[UserName, RemoteAddressIP4, LogonTime])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=([count(), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, RemoteAddressIP4], multival=false)]))
| sort(_count, order=desc)
